first_answers.text:
The floor dimensions are 7'6" (7.5 ft) by 11'8" (11.666... ft). Linoleum comes in 6-ft wide rolls sold by the running foot at $1.79 per foot. To minimize the total linear feet purchased, the roll should be run along the shorter dimension (7.5 ft). This requires two strips: one full 6-ft wide strip and a second strip cut from another 6-ft width to cover the remaining 5.666... ft. Each strip is 7.5 ft long, so total linear feet = 2 × 7.5 = 15 ft. Cost = 15 × $1.79 = $26.85.

ANSWER: B
